title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows (Book 7)
author: J. K. Rowling

adhd.label: Step 1 · Jumps to Ch. 21: The Tale of the Three Brothers — The Cloak, The Stone & The Wand (Start Here)
adhd.brief: Hermione reads the fairy tale of the three brothers who outwitted Death, explaining the triangular eye symbol: the unbeatable Elder Wand, the Resurrection Stone, and the true Invisibility Cloak.

adhd.label: Step 2 · Jumps to Ch. 26: The Gringotts Dragon Breakout — Heist in the Lestrange Vault
adhd.brief: Disguised with Polyjuice Potion, Harry, Ron, and Hermione infiltrate Gringotts, seize Hufflepuff's cup from multiplying burning treasures, and unchain a half-blind Ukrainian Ironbelly dragon to fly free over London.

adhd.label: Step 3 · Jumps to Ch. 33: The Prince's Tale — Snape's Memories & 'Always'
adhd.brief: Harry pours Snape's dying tears into the Pensieve, revealing Severus's lifelong love for Lily, his pact with Dumbledore, the silver doe Patronus, and the truth that Harry himself carries a fragment of Voldemort's soul.

adhd.label: Step 4 · Jumps to Ch. 34–36: The Forest Again, King's Cross Station & The Flaw in the Plan
adhd.brief: Harry walks unarmed into the Forbidden Forest to surrender his life, awakens in a spotless King's Cross Station with Dumbledore, and returns to the Great Hall to explain why the Elder Wand will not strike him.
